description: Full-size Caproni Ca.33 replica displayed airside on level 2 of the Bratislava terminal; commemorates Milan Rastislav Štefánik who was killed in a Caproni Ca.33 crash near Ivanka pri Dunaji on 4 May 1919; recorded as a replica
